jobs.occupation: Project Manager of the PUNCH4NFDI Consortium in the NFDI (Physiker/in)
jobs.description: For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:Project Manager of the PUNCH4NFDI Consortium in the NFDILimited: 31.12.2028 | Starting date: 01.01.2027 | ID: FHMA031/2026 | Deadline: 03.12.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possibleDESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.The PUNCH4NFDI consortium aims at a sustainable utilisation of research data and the establishment of FAIR and open science for particle physics, astroparticle physics, astronomy, and hadron&nuclear physics. The consortium is part of the German national research data infrastructure (Nationale Forschungsdaten­infrastruktur, NFDI) and supported by around 35 institutions - university institutes, Max Planck institutes, Helmholtz centres, as well as Leibniz institutes. As project manager of PUNCH4NFDI, you are a central point of coordination. You oversee the execution of the consortium's work plan and build bridges to other consortia in the NFDI. You organise the internal procedures of the consortium, and you support the spokesperson of the consortium in technical and administrative matters, with the assistance of a project office at DESY. An important part of your work is in supporting the transition of the consortium into a new NFDI structure foreseen to become effective in 2029.About your role:- Coordination of scientific and technical work in PUNCH4NFDI- Coordination of PUNCH4NFDI administration (funding, reporting)- Communication and networking within PUNCH4NFDI and with its partners and stakeholders- Supporting the transition into the post-2028 era of the NFDI- Preparation of PUNCH4NFDI meetingsAbout you:- Ph.D. or equivalent qualification in one of the scientific disciplines of PUNCH4NFDI (particle physics, astroparticle physics, astronomy, and hadron&nuclear physics)- Experience or proven interest in project management, preferably in science- Excellent networking and communication skills- Good mastering of written and spoken German and English- Good team working ability- Experience or proven interest in scientific computing or data management is a plus- Interest in science communicationGood reasons to join:Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our staff are central to us, with gender equality forming a key part of this commitment. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.For further information please contact Dr. Thomas Schörner, +49 40 8998-3429 (https://tel:+494089983429) , thomas.schoerner@desy.de (thomas.schoerner@desy.de)Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation, CV and relevant certificates).We look forward to receiving your application via our application portal:Apply now! (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/134664)DESY promotes equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/134664/2/2544) . We therefore welcome applications from people of all dimensions of diversity. The professional development of women (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/134664/2/2820) is very important to us and therefore we strongly encourage women to apply for the vacant position. Applications from severely disabled persons and those with equivalent status will be given preference if they are equally qualified (sbv.desy.de (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/134664/2/780) ).You can find further information here:https://www.desy.de/career/apprenticeship/ (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/134664/2/3781)Deutsches Elektronen-Synchrotron DESYHuman Resources Department | Notkestraße 85 | 22607 HamburgPhone: +49 40 8998‑3392 (https://tel:+494089983392)

jobs.occupation: Senior IT Consultant (f/m/d) SAP Revenue Accounting & Reporting (RAR) (Informationsmanager/in)
jobs.description: Job RequirementsDo you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?Then come and join our global SAP P58 Template & Operations team as Senior IT Consultant (f/m/d) SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR).The SAP P58 RAR team is responsible for ensuring accurate revenue recognition and revenue reporting in accordance with IFRS 15 and local accounting standards (Local GAAP). As a Senior SAP P58 RAR Consultant, you will work alongside a highly skilled team of SAP RAR consultants and specialists. You will design and implement changes and projects, manage external service providers, support operational activities, and drive international country rollouts within the SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) and Optimized Contract Management (OCM) environmentChoose the best place for your work - Within the scope of this position, it is possible, in consultation with your manager, to work mobile (within Germany) up to an average volume of 60% of the respective working hours.Even more flexibility? Mobile working from abroad is possible for up to 30 days a year under certain conditions and in selected countries.Your tasks and responsibilities:* You will ensure the stable operation of SAP RAR and SAP OCM applications for business users, as well as accurate revenue reporting and timely month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities.* You will represent the team in regular meetings and in the monthly SAP P58 Template & Operations Town Hall.* You will coordinate closely with SAP P58 Application and Functional Leads to advance integration topics. In addition, you will collaborate with the P58 AMS Lead on escalation management and advise the P58 Template Governance as well as business departments on new requirements, changes, and projects.* You will take ownership of the high-quality end-to-end delivery of changes and projects in the SAP RAR and SAP OCM environment, including design, configuration, and integration with additional SAP modules and systems.* You will drive SAP RAR and OCM implementations as the responsible consultant within ongoing international P58 country rollout projects.* You will manage stakeholders and projects, including planning, risk assessment, and risk mitigation.* You will ensure that external service providers deliver agreed services and monitor their performance based on defined KPIs.* You will ensure audit and compliance adherence in line with regulatory, internal, and industry-specific requirements, including IFRS 15 and ASC 606.To find out more about the specific business, have a look at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/products-servicesYour qualifications and experience:* You have successfully completed a degree in Business Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a comparable field. Relevant SAP certifications are an advantage.* You have many years of professional experience in the IT environment with a focus on SAP RAR and SAP OCM as well as related SAP modules.* In addition, you bring in-depth expertise in the end-to-end implementation of RAR/OCM solutions and in solution design across related modules. Experience with BRF+ is an advantage.* You also have proven experience in IT project management.* Furthermore, you have a very good understanding of financial processes and the standards IFRS 15 and ASC 606.* You have profound knowledge of IT Service Management as well as ITIL V3/V4, IT Quality, and Compliance.* In addition, you have comprehensive knowledge of the ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 standards as well as the regulatory requirements for non-product software in a global healthcare company.Your attributes and skills:* As you will work with different business units, functions, and regions, you have business-fluent English language skills, both written and spoken.* You stand out through strong analytical skills and excellent problem-solving abilities.* You bring very good communication and presentation skills as well as solid consulting expertise. You find it easy to collaborate with different stakeholders.* You possess strong change management and project management competencies. You are able to efficiently manage multiple projects and support requests in parallel.* You are committed, proactive, and passionate about contributing to the success of Siemens Healthineers.* International business travel is a welcome opportunity for you to support local key users and accompany operational SAP activities on site (approximately 5-10% travel activity).Our global team:Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.Our culture:Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That's why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success.Check our Careers Site at https://careers.siemens-healthineers.com/global/enAs an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Click here to get started.To all recruitment agencies:Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. We delete and destroy unsolicited information, thus, would recommend you refrain from any such practices. Your adherence to our policies is appreciated.

Constructor University is a private, state-accredited, English-language research university located on a green, 34-hectare residential campus in Bremen, Germany. Founded in 2001, the university offers Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD programs across three schools: the School of Science, the School of Computer Science and Engineering, and the School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences. Constructor University is home to approximately 2,500 students and researchers from more than 120 countries. All teaching, research, and academic administration are conducted in English, within an international community that is among the most diverse of any university in Germany. According to the 2027 Times Higher Education World University Rankings, Constructor University ranks among the top 17 percent of universities worldwide in both Social Sciences and Engineering; moreover, it scores 92 out of 100 for International Outlook and 84 out of 100 for Industry. The indicators that reflect both the quality of its academic environment and the breadth of its engagement with the wider world.The School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences brings together management, behavioral science, data analytics, and decision theory under one roof. Its programs, ranging from undergraduate studies in International Business Administration to the MBA, MSc in Data Science for Society and Business, and doctoral education, attract professionally ambitious and internationally minded students. The School is also home to approximately 50 doctoral researchers, contributing to an active and growing research environment. Marketing represents a strategic new direction for the School, and this position offers an opportunity to help shape the field from the outset, develop an independent research agenda in a genuinely interdisciplinary environment, and contribute to a School that is actively expanding.Constructor University invites applications for the following position, to be filled ideally by Fall 2027:Assistant Professor of Marketing (f/m/d)(Full-time; 38,5h/week, tenure-track)School of Business, Social and Decision SciencesYour Responsibilities:In this position, you will support our research and teaching activities in the field of Marketing. The successful candidate will be teaching courses (for example Digital Marketing), supporting and advising students on their studies and supervising Bachelor, Master’s and PhD theses and research projects.Possible areas of interest are: - Design and teach innovative, contemporary modules in Marketing at undergraduate and master’s levels, including within MBA, MA, and MSc programs.- Engage, advise, and mentor students; supervise Bachelor’s, Master’s theses, and doctoral research- Build and sustain an active research agenda with publications in leading peer-reviewed journals- Establish a research group and pursue external funding from national and international sources- Contribute to curriculum development, new program initiatives, and departmental serviceThe university is highly supportive of junior faculty, providing both formal and informal mentoring, administrative support, as well as a flexible budget for establishing an internationally visible research group. Several opportunities exist to develop transdisciplinary research projects in collaboration with other research groups or our industrial partners.Your Qualifications and Experience:- PhD in Marketing or a closely related field- Evidence of high-quality research and a strong publication pipeline- Ability to design and teach core Marketing courses at undergraduate and graduate levels- Expertise in areas such as Digital Marketing, Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behavior, AI in Marketing, or related fields is particularly welcome- Readiness to pursue external research funding and contribute to collaborative research projects- Ability and willingness to supervise Bachelor’s and Master’s theses and contribute to doctoral supervision- Willingness to work and teach in a multicultural, English-speaking academic environment- Excellent written and spoken English and strong intercultural competenceWhat you can expect at Constructor University: Constructor University guarantees the academic freedom of every faculty member. Junior faculty receive formal and informal mentoring, administrative support, and dedicated start-up and research group budgets to help establish their work. The university has an active portfolio of Horizon Europe and Erasmus+ funded projects and a culture of interdisciplinary collaboration across its three schools, creating genuine opportunities for joint initiatives and externally funded research. Beyond the academic environment, you will find a campus that is genuinely close-knit: small classes, direct faculty-student engagement, and a community where diversity is lived rather than declared. Language courses and sports facilities are part of everyday life on campus. Constructor University consistently achieves top results in national and international university rankings, in the CHE Ranking, the most comprehensive and detailed ranking of the German-speaking higher education landscape, Constructor University has achieved top placements every year since its first participation in 2005. The campus is located in Bremen. Bremen is a vibrant, livable Hanseatic city with an international character, affordable by European standards, well connected by rail and air, and home to a growing academic and innovation community. Relocating here is, for most, a pleasant discovery.The position is tenure-track, with review after an initial three-year contract, followed by a second three-year contract. Successful evaluation leads to permanence and typically promotion to Associate Professor level. Constructor University is an equal opportunity employer and particularly welcomes applications that would improve the university’s faculty profile with reference to gender and national origin.Your Application:If you have any questions about the position, please contact Prof. Dr. Çağrı Bulut via Mail (cbulut@constructor.university (https://mailto:cbulut@constructor.university) ).Constructor University offers full equal opportunity to all qualified applications. We value diversity and inclusion and encourage all qualified people to apply. We especially encourage applications from traditionally underrepresented groups.Please upload your documents in a single PDF document, including a letter of motivation stating your field of expertise, curriculum vitae, teaching portfolio, publication record, copies of certificates and diplomas, certification of English proficiency (optional), and the names and addresses of two referees in our application management system.The deadline for submission of applications 15.01.2027.The review of applications will begin immediately.Please note that only applications submitted through the official application portal will be considered for recognition.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.description: Imagine a future where you play a key role in ensuring electrical safety across our offshore substations and wind turbines while helping us push the boundaries of safe, efficient, and reliable offshore operations.Join us in this role where you’ll take independent ownership of electrical safety within your area of responsibility, overseeing electrical installations on wind turbines in our German wind farms. You’ll combine your deep technical expertise with on-site presence—both at your permanent base in Norddeich and offshore—in order to guide colleagues, strengthen procedures, and ensure safe systems of work.Welcome to HV and Transmission GERYou’ll be part of HV and Transmission GER, where you and your colleagues will ensure electrical safety governance and operational support across high-voltage infrastructure in our German offshore wind farms. Your team is dedicated to managing safety-critical systems, uplifting operational standards, and sharing expertise across the organisation.As a team, we collaborate closely, support one another’s development, and bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset to every challenge.You’ll play an important role in:- preparing and reviewing risk assessments for offshore electrical work- supporting the selection, training, and supervision of Authorised Persons, electricians, and electrically instructed persons offshore- contributing to the qualification and supervision of contractors in the offshore electrical environment- developing, implementing, and improving maintenance plans for offshore electrical installations- coordinating multiple employers involved in offshore electrical activities- planning, organising, delivering, and documenting electrical safety training- implementing, strengthening, and regularly reviewing the Wind Turbine Safety Rules (WTSR) and Orsted Electrical Safety Rules (OESR)- assuming designated roles within the Safe Systems of Work, such as Authorising Engineer, Authorising Officer, or Training Mentor- auditing work processes before offshore deployment.To succeed in the role, you:- have completed a degree within electrical engineering, or equivalent- bring strong expertise within electrical safety, including standards, laws, and regulations- demonstrate technical leadership competence- offer switching experience in high-voltage environments above 20 kV- communicate confidently in both English and German at B2 level or higher- are comfortable using IT systems, including Microsoft Office, SAP, and AI tools- ideally have a qualification for live working, experience with wind turbines, or prior responsibility as an electrician- meet the minimum competency requirements within your onboarding timeframe, supported by our learning and development processes.**Country-specific requirements: **fulfil the requirements of a responsible electrician (vEFK) according to VDE 1000-10.Please note that in this role you will be mainly working in our office in Norddeich from Monday to Friday. An important part of the role will be an inspection of plants and the professional guidance of the electricians. This requires partial work offshore (20-40%) in a 7- or 14-day shift pattern.Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.Shape the future with usSend your application to us as soon as possible.
